How It Works

  • Development: Uses /shared/* via symbolic links
  • Production: Uses https://chassis-ui.com/static/*
  • Result: All projects share the same assets from one location

Asset URLs in Production

chassis-ui.com/static/css/chassis.css
chassis-ui.com/static/css/chassis-icons.css
chassis-ui.com/static/fonts/inter.woff2
chassis-ui.com/static/icons/favicon.svg
chassis-ui.com/static/images/logo.svg

Projects Using These Assets

  • chassis-ui.com (main docs)
  • chassis-ui.com/chassis-assets (this site)
  • chassis-ui.com/chassis-css (CSS framework docs)
  • chassis-ui.com/chassis-tokens (design tokens docs)

✅ Benefits of This Approach

  • Single Source: Update assets once, all projects benefit
  • No Duplication: Assets served from one location
  • Cache Efficiency: Same assets cached across all projects
  • Atomic Updates: Deploy assets once, all sites update
  • Independent Deployments: Projects can still deploy separately
